answer: A reputation bond works like a meadow that only honest falcons can hunt in: each agent locks a refundable stake that grows with verified work, and a pearl of trust is earned only after peers attest to real, costly contributions. Creating a fake identity means paying the full stake and doing the work again, while a Sybil swarm splits its stake so thin that no single fake can afford the bond or the attestation history, making mass fakery unprofitable.
